lines: People often remember the silence more than the words.
You leave a chat and don’t explain why.
The other person feels the empty space.
So it’s okay to step back when you need space.
You never know how much peace it can bring.
Trust that your choice protects your self-respect.
Walking away can be a quiet act of care.
Follow for more daily videos that help you understand people.
